entries.title: Threebot 0.1.7
entries.note: v0.1.7 · 11 changes from 3 contributors Rooms. Put several Bots in one room, talk to them together, and run panels or roundtables where they answer each other. See what's new. Updates now show their release notes in the app, with who made each change. Your other machines. See linked machines, open their threads in Threebot, and get told when one goes offline. Bots from existing projects. Turn a project you already have into a Bot without touching its git. Shape a Bot's role. Give a Bot its role when you create it, and edit its standing instructions later. Better composer. An @ mention menu, and lists that continue when you press Enter. PDFs, Mac app and dictation. View PDFs in chat, a steadier Mac app window and microphone, and OpenAI or Gemini dictation (beta). Plus 1 more change. entries.title: Threebot 0.1.3
entries.note: What's new Avatars act out what the Bot is doing. They think, search, write, run tools, wait for you or celebrate, using the engine's full set of animations instead of a spinning ring. ( #22 ) New avatar editor. It uses Open Bot Avatar 0.2.0, and drawing a new avatar now happens in the background, with Use, Try again or Discard, instead of in the Bot's chat. ( #16 ) Live PR chips. Each chip shows its PR's real status (Open, Draft, Merged or Closed, plus checks), and merged or closed chips go away. ( #15 ) App logos on connect cards. The cards now show the app's logo, with a check badge once the app is connected. ( #21 ) The server is now TypeScript. Node runs it directly and tsrs type-checks it. ( #23 ) New landing page: dark, with the app drawn live. ( #20 ) Requires Node 22.18 or newer. Existing installs update as usual from Settings → Updates or with threebot update . Full changelog:

entries.title: Threebot 0.1.2
entries.note: What's new Update button. A button in the sidebar footer appears when a new release is out. Threebot checks every 15 minutes, and Settings → Updates has a "Check now" button with the last-checked time. ( #9 ) Update automatically. A new switch in Settings → Updates, off by default. It installs new releases only when no Bot is busy, and rolls back if the new version doesn't start. ( #11 ) Projects is now a beta. Turn it on in Settings → Beta. Installs that already have a board keep it on. ( #12 ) tsrs. The web app is now type-checked with tsrs, the Rust port of TypeScript 7. ( #14 ) Install or update: Settings → Updates, or threebot update . Full changelog: v0.1.1...v0.1.2
